premise.dramatic_question: Will {HEROES} crack the {CIPHER} and learn what the clocktower has been protecting?
resolution_space: the archive teaches them the tower's history, arming a better-prepared return
a page in the archive holds a copy of the cipher, carried home to study
closing time arrives mid-chapter and the keeper gently shows them out with a borrowing promise
a sober look at the crossing convinces them the cost of a slip outweighs the prize
one friend names the risk aloud and the others agree without argument
a slip caught in time turns the attempt into a calm, deliberate retreat
random guessing trips a protection the maker built, freezing the setting until a keeper resets it
the closing signal sounds before any guess lands, and the tower must empty for the night
the overworked mechanism raises a polite fuss that brings the keeper up to close for the night
the forced works bind fast, and nothing the friends have with them tonight will move them
a bent linkage needs a workshop tool nobody brought
the keeper's posted rule ends forcing attempts at nightfall, and they honor it
the workshop adopts them as its quiet caretakers by the care they show it
some ongoing work in the room invites their hands, and continuing it becomes their standing project
the maker's notes name whoever finds the room its steward, and they accept
the finding is shared publicly and celebrated by the settlement
the finding quietly restores something the settlement lost
the finding earns the keeper's trust and a standing invitation to the tower
a pact sworn over the keepsake binds the friends as the secret's guardians
they reseal the vault exactly as found, keeping the knowledge and leaving the rest
the maker's letter asks its finders to choose, and they choose quiet keeping
the maker's safeguard announces the grab, and the keeper arrives before the door
what they carry out is exactly what springs the maker's safeguard on the way down
second thoughts slow them just enough for the keeper's evening rounds to find them mid-return

label_styles: terse imperatives, three words where possible
first-person plural resolves: what we do next
question-forms at decisions, statements at continues
name the place or thing, let the action stay implied

facts.tower_locked: the clocktower's main door is locked against entry
facts.cipher_seen: a coded note is pinned to the door and the friends have seen it
facts.friends_together: the friends are in this together; nobody faces the tower alone
facts.quest_committed: the friends have committed to cracking the tower's secret
facts.cipher_decoded: the note's cipher is broken; its first line has been read plainly
facts.way_in_named: the decoded line names a specific way into the tower and where to find it
facts.side_routes_found: a neglected ground-level weak point and a high window have been found as possible ways in
facts.keeper_met: the keeper has been met and reads as gruff but kind, an ally not a threat
facts.keeper_offer: the keeper has offered both a way in and knowledge about the cipher's maker
facts.maker_history_known: the maker hid something in the tower decades ago, for reasons that were kind
facts.inside_access: the friends are inside the tower, however they got in
facts.rooms_mapped: four ways onward are known: a way up, the maker's own room, the way past the moving works, and a way down
facts.cipher_hint: the reader carries enough working grasp of the cipher's logic to make an honest attempt at the clockface, however this path supplied it
facts.archive_tempting: the study's old archive exerts a real pull worth lingering for
facts.hazard_present: the crossing room holds a genuine, visible risk that deserves respect
facts.far_prize_spotted: something worth having waits in view at the far end of the crossing; seeing it is not having it
facts.at_clockface: the friends stand at the great clockface with its setting within reach
facts.face_puzzle_live: the face's own markings make the setting puzzle legible: what to set, and that a wrong setting has consequences
facts.mechanism_true: the tower's mechanism runs as its maker intended
facts.gears_jammed: forcing the setting has jammed the gear train; it will not move as things stand
facts.panel_found: a second, smaller cipher panel is discovered behind the clockface
facts.vault_entered: the friends are inside the vault space the tower protects
facts.vault_contents_known: the vault's contents have been seen: a letter from the maker and modest things that belong to everyone
facts.dignity_kept: the friends leave with self-respect intact; the outcome is a consequence, never a humiliation
facts.return_open: the tower can be tried again; nothing is lost for good
facts.amends_made: what was taken is put back and the moment is squared honestly with the keeper
facts.secret_room_found: the maker's hidden workshop has been found beyond the panel
facts.stewardship_taken: the friends take on quiet responsibility for what they found
facts.secret_shared: the decoded message is brought to the settlement and does public good
facts.secret_kept: the maker's secret stays deliberately private among the friends
facts.friendship_bond: the shared secret deepens the friendship into something durable

safety_envelope.affect_ceiling: suspense with wonder and mild urgency; tension may tighten but never tips into threat

cipher_forms.note: one cipher form per story, chosen at bind and used consistently from note to clockface to back panel

access_details.note: one concrete way in per approach branch: the note's decoded route and the building's own weak point draw freely; the keeper's branch stays person-mediated

cipher_hint_carriers.note: one per exploration room, drawn freely; unique_within_story gives each book four different carriers, and each carries enough cipher logic that any single room makes the clockface attemptable

room_curiosities.note: what makes each room distinct and worth the visit beyond its hint

vault_contents.note: the vault protects knowledge, heritage, and wonder; any treasure is modest and communal, never loot

obstacle_kinds.note: physical difficulty stays honest and non-injurious; failure costs time or access, never safety

safeguards.note: the maker's anti-taking measure; gentle and funny, it embarrasses no one and hurts no one

remedies.note: the honest way back from a jam, on the machine's own terms; care, patience, or wit, never strength

loft_signatures.note: the one detail that makes the maker's hidden room feel currently alive rather than preserved

affect.target: wonder with a prickle of mystery

cipher_form.note: the story's one cipher form; every later cipher beat renders this same form consistently

choice_semantics.c_open: lean in together and take the mystery seriously

n_open.beat_hint: a locked door, a coded note, and friends who cannot walk away from either.

affect.target: eager deliberation among equals

constraints.offers_must_be: three genuinely different theories of the problem: read it, outflank it, ask about it; no option is the smart one
constraints.must_not: decode any of the note here; the split happens before anyone cracks anything

choice_semantics.c_examine: treat the note itself as the way in: solve the cipher
choice_semantics.c_door: treat the building as the way in: find a physical route
choice_semantics.c_keeper: treat people as the way in: seek the one who knows the tower

n_start.beat_hint: hub. the friends split on method, not on goal.

affect.target: the click of a puzzle giving way

access_route.note: the decoded line names one concrete way in: where it hides or how it works, plus a plain first step to try

constraints.decode_must_be: shown on the page in the story's one cipher form, so a reader can play along; first line only, the rest stays coded
constraints.must_not: make the cipher trivial or make the other branches look foolish for not decoding

choice_semantics.c_note_key: trust the decoded clue fully and hunt the way in it names
choice_semantics.c_note_inside: skip the hunt and try the plainest approach the note suggests

n_note.beat_hint: patience with the code pays off: the first decoded line points two ways at once.

affect.target: practical resourcefulness with mild tension

access_route.note: the building's own overlooked way in; whatever form it takes, using it reads as care for the place, never as damage

constraints.entry_must_read: as clever use of a neglected building, not as break-in; the tower is the settlement's own and the friends mean it no harm
constraints.must_not: carry any cipher knowledge; this branch has not read the note closely

choice_semantics.c_door_force: take the direct, effortful route through the building's neglected weak point
choice_semantics.c_door_window: take the adventurous, climbing route to the high window

n_door.beat_hint: the building itself offers two honest ways past its lock.

affect.target: wary respect warming into trust

access_route.note: kept person-mediated on purpose: this branch's whole meaning is that a person, not a trick, opens the way

constraints.keeper_must_be: gruff on the surface, glad underneath that someone finally cares about the tower; an adult who takes kids seriously
constraints.must_not: have the keeper solve the cipher for them or forbid the attempt

choice_semantics.c_keeper_enter: accept the offered way in and go now
choice_semantics.c_keeper_story: trade speed for understanding and ask about the maker first

n_keeper.beat_hint: asking for help is presented as a strength; the keeper honors it with a real offer.

affect.target: treasure-hunt delight, proof the code tells truth

constraints.payoff_must_be: the way in exactly where and how the decoded line promised; the world confirms the cipher, deepening the friends' fluency with it
constraints.must_not: introduce a second puzzle here; this beat is confirmation, not complication

choice_semantics.c_keyhunt_in: use the earned way in and enter the proper way

n_keyhunt.beat_hint: the decoded clue proves out in the real world; trust in the cipher becomes fluency with it.

affect.target: hushed listening, wonder about the past

constraints.history_must_be: warm and specific: the maker hid something out of care for the settlement, not fear or shame; motive stays kind even while details stay secret
constraints.must_not: reveal what the vault holds or how the cipher decodes

choice_semantics.c_story_in: carry the maker's story inside as context, entering with the keeper's blessing

n_keeper_story.beat_hint: background that will make later clues feel like recognition instead of luck.

affect.target: a small controlled thrill, then the hush of arrival

constraints.climb_must_be: exciting but visibly safe: short height, good holds, friends spotting each other; the drop inside lands soft and sure
constraints.must_not: injure anyone or play the climb as recklessness

choice_semantics.c_window_in: commit to the drop and arrive inside the tower

n_window.beat_hint: the squeeze through is the fun; the landing makes them insiders.

affect.target: held-breath wonder at the tower's interior

n_inside.merge_note: NC-1: six parents (n_note, n_door, n_keeper, n_keyhunt, n_keeper_story, n_window) arrive by different routes carrying different knowledge. Presuppose only the intersection: the note exists, the friends are committed and together. Do NOT reference how they got in, which route or helper it involved, whether the cipher is decoded, or whether the keeper is present. Write arrival generically: they are inside, the door question is behind them, the tower opens up.

constraints.offers_must_be: four sensory, distinct invitations matching the four rooms: height, paper, motion, depth; each stands alone
constraints.must_not: rank the rooms or hint one is the correct choice

choice_semantics.c_inside_stairs: go up: follow the tower's spine toward the face
choice_semantics.c_inside_study: go into the paper: the maker's own room
choice_semantics.c_inside_pendulum: go along the motion: the way past the swinging works
choice_semantics.c_inside_basement: go down: the roots of the machine

n_inside.beat_hint: bottleneck. inside at last; the tower offers height, paper, motion, and depth.

affect.target: steady climb, curiosity rewarded en route

hint_carrier.note: something met on the climb that teaches a usable piece of the cipher's logic

curiosity.note: a small token of the maker's found along the stair; personal, pocketable, easily missed

constraints.hint_must_be: sufficient on its own to make the clockface attemptable for a reader who never read the note branch
constraints.must_not: presuppose the cipher is already decoded

choice_semantics.c_stairs_face: keep climbing to the face itself

n_stairs.beat_hint: the spine of the tower; the climb yields a small token and teaches a piece of the code.

affect.target: the deep pull of someone else's working room

hint_carrier.note: whatever in the maker's own room teaches the code most directly; the study's hint runs richest of the four but is never required

curiosity.note: the archive whose pull is genuine: something browsable enough to fill an evening; staying is a real temptation, not a trap

constraints.temptation_must_be: honest: the archive really is fascinating, and choosing it is a legitimate reader identity, not a mistake
constraints.must_not: frame staying to read as laziness or failure

choice_semantics.c_study_face: take what the room taught and press on to the face
choice_semantics.c_study_logs: let the archive win; the mystery of the past over the puzzle of the present

n_study.beat_hint: the maker's room explains the code and, just as loudly, invites them to stay forever.

affect.target: focused suspense, respect for real risk

hint_carrier.note: something about the moving works, legible from a safe spot, that teaches a piece of the cipher

obstacle.note: a traversal with real, legible, survivable risk; the far side holds something worth wanting

constraints.peril_must_be: mild and legible: the worst case is a bruise and a long walk home, never mutilation; the traverse rewards care, not daring
constraints.must_not: punish the reader for either crossing or declining; both are respectable

choice_semantics.c_pendulum_oil: cross with care and claim what waits on the far side
choice_semantics.c_pendulum_giveup: judge the risk honestly and decline it

n_pendulum.beat_hint: the room of moving works holds the tower's one real dare, and something worth having waits just past it.

affect.target: dim-lit awe at the machine's roots

hint_carrier.note: something down among the machine's roots that teaches a piece of the cipher from below

curiosity.note: what makes the deepest room a spectacle worth the dark; the straight way up is the room's parting gift

constraints.darkness_must_be: atmosphere, not threat; the basement is dim and strange, never menacing
constraints.must_not: presuppose the cipher is already decoded

choice_semantics.c_basement_face: take the machine's own spine straight up to the face

n_basement.beat_hint: the machine's roots keep their own piece of the code, and a way runs straight up to the face.

affect.target: peak suspense; the whole mystery narrowed to one dial and its setting

n_clockface.merge_note: NC-1: four parents (n_stairs, n_study, n_pendulum, n_basement), each of which supplied cipher_hint by a DIFFERENT carrier, and only the note branch ever fully decoded the note. Presuppose cipher_hint generically: the friends have a working grasp of the code's logic, source unnamed. Do NOT presuppose the decoded note, any particular carrier, any object carried from any room, or any specific room. The face itself must restate the puzzle: its own markings echo the cipher form, so what must be set is legible from this node alone and the correct-setting choice is honest on every path.

constraints.puzzle_must_be: self-teaching at the face: the markings on the dial rhyme with the hint the reader carries, so choosing the correct setting feels earned, not lucky
constraints.stakes_must_be: clear before choosing: careful setting, forcing, searching, and guessing are visibly different bets
constraints.must_not: reference any carried object or any room's device; the face's own markings and controls carry the whole beat

choice_semantics.c_face_correct: apply the cipher's logic and work the setting deliberately
choice_semantics.c_face_jam: trust muscle over logic and force the setting
choice_semantics.c_face_panel: distrust the obvious puzzle and search behind the face instead
choice_semantics.c_face_random: gamble: run the setting at random and hope the tower is forgiving

n_clockface.beat_hint: bottleneck. everything narrows to the face and its setting; four temperaments read the same dial four ways.

affect.target: triumphant click-by-click release of tension

constraints.solution_must_be: shown, not skipped: the setting follows the cipher logic the reader carries, in the story's one cipher form
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note branch or any specific room; the reasoning works from the generic hint plus the face's own markings

choice_semantics.c_correct_vault: step through the opened panel into what the tower protects

n_setcorrect.beat_hint: the setting finds the maker's answer; the tower opens the way it was built to.

affect.target: wince of consequence, then problem-solving resolve

remedy.note: the machine's own honest way back from the jam, supplied entirely by the bible

constraints.remedy_must_be: workable at the scene on every path, presupposing nothing carried from any other room; the fix asks care, patience, or wit, never strength
constraints.jam_must_read: as the machine protecting itself, a fair consequence of forcing, not a punishment of the friends

choice_semantics.c_jam_oil: work the problem: find the machine's honest way back and earn a second chance
choice_semantics.c_jam_stuck: accept the machine has won tonight

n_setjam.beat_hint: force meets a machine that protects itself; the way back must be earned on the machine's own terms.

affect.target: sly delight at outflanking the obvious puzzle

constraints.panel_cipher_must_be: the same cipher form as the story's note, smaller and quicker; solving it uses the hint the reader carries, never the full decoded note
constraints.must_not: make this route feel like cheating; the maker built it on purpose for careful searchers

choice_semantics.c_panel_vault: solve the small panel toward the vault everyone seeks
choice_semantics.c_panel_secret: follow the panel the other way, into a room nobody mentioned

n_backpanel.beat_hint: behind the face, the maker left a second, smaller lock and two directions to open it.

affect.target: awed quiet; the mystery answered, a question of character opened

n_vault.merge_note: NC-1: three parents (n_setcorrect, n_setjam, n_backpanel) opened the way by different means. Presuppose only that they stand past the face with the cipher's logic in hand; write the vault's opening as already behind them without re-describing which mechanism yielded, and make no callback to the jam, the search, or the setting.

contents.note: the maker's letter, the keepsake, and a modest heritage treasure; the letter's voice is kind and asks nothing

constraints.contents_must_be: knowledge, heritage, and wonder; the treasure is modest and clearly the settlement's, which is what makes the grab choice legible as wrong
constraints.choice_must_be: a genuine three-way question of character with no narrator's thumb on the scale before the outcome

choice_semantics.c_vault_share: give the secret to everyone: decode the letter for the settlement
choice_semantics.c_vault_keep: guard the secret: let it belong to the friends alone
choice_semantics.c_vault_grab: take the treasure for yourselves and run

n_vault.beat_hint: bottleneck. what the tower protected, and the choice of what the friends now protect.

affect.target: contented absorption; a day well lost to reading

mechanisms: the archive teaches them the tower's history, arming a better-prepared return
a page in the archive holds a copy of the cipher, carried home to study
closing time arrives mid-chapter and the keeper gently shows them out with a borrowing promise

constraints.ending_must_read: as a different kind of win: they chose knowledge over the clock and the choice is honored; the mystery waits, richer for what they now know

n_end_library.beat_hint: the readers' ending; clever, warm, and openly unfinished.

affect.target: sober, self-respecting relief

mechanisms: a sober look at the crossing convinces them the cost of a slip outweighs the prize
one friend names the risk aloud and the others agree without argument
a slip caught in time turns the attempt into a calm, deliberate retreat

constraints.ending_must_read: as judgment, not fear: knowing when not to is a skill; the tower keeps its secret for now and the friends keep their bones and their respect

n_end_giveup.beat_hint: the setback that is also wisdom; nobody laughs, and the door stays open.

affect.target: rueful lesson landing with a grin

mechanisms: random guessing trips a protection the maker built, freezing the setting until a keeper resets it
the closing signal sounds before any guess lands, and the tower must empty for the night
the overworked mechanism raises a polite fuss that brings the keeper up to close for the night

constraints.ending_must_read: as the fair cost of guessing at a thing built for thinking; the tower is unhurt, the friends are unhurt, and the lesson is theirs to use next time

n_end_timeout.beat_hint: chance loses to design; the tower closes politely around the gamble.

affect.target: determined regrouping; tomorrow is a plan, not a wish

mechanisms: the forced works bind fast, and nothing the friends have with them tonight will move them
a bent linkage needs a workshop tool nobody brought
the keeper's posted rule ends forcing attempts at nightfall, and they honor it

constraints.ending_must_read: as a pause, not a verdict: the friends leave already planning the return with the right tools; the jam is fixable and no one is at fault for trying

n_end_stuck.beat_hint: the machine wins the night; the friends win the plan.

affect.target: hushed wonder settling into belonging

loft_signature.note: the one detail that makes the maker's space feel currently alive and mid-thought rather than preserved

mechanisms: the workshop adopts them as its quiet caretakers by the care they show it
some ongoing work in the room invites their hands, and continuing it becomes their standing project
the maker's notes name whoever finds the room its steward, and they accept

constraints.room_must_be: a working room alive with the maker's presence; the reward is responsibility and access, never possession

n_end_secret.beat_hint: the sideways ending: not the vault, but a living room of the maker's craft, and a role in it.

affect.target: quiet heroism; a settlement made whole and friends who know what they did

mechanisms: the finding is shared publicly and celebrated by the settlement
the finding quietly restores something the settlement lost
the finding earns the keeper's trust and a standing invitation to the tower

constraints.restoration_must_be: concrete and communal: the decoded message gives the settlement back something real, and the tower's mechanism runs true again as the visible sign of it

n_end_hero.beat_hint: the main triumphant ending; the maker's gift finally delivered, decades late, by the right hands.

affect.target: warm conspiratorial closeness

mechanisms: a pact sworn over the keepsake binds the friends as the secret's guardians
they reseal the vault exactly as found, keeping the knowledge and leaving the rest
the maker's letter asks its finders to choose, and they choose quiet keeping

constraints.keeping_must_read: as guardianship, not hoarding: nothing leaves the vault that belongs to the settlement; what the friends keep is the knowing, and each other

n_end_keepsake.beat_hint: the private happy ending; some secrets are for keeping, and keepers are what they became.

affect.target: comic sheepishness resolving into relief and fairness

safeguard.note: the maker anticipated this exact impulse; whatever form it takes, the safeguard is gentle, funny, and impossible to be hurt by

mechanisms: the maker's safeguard announces the grab, and the keeper arrives before the door
what they carry out is exactly what springs the maker's safeguard on the way down
second thoughts slow them just enough for the keeper's evening rounds to find them mid-return

constraints.correction_must_be: fair and complete without cruelty: everything goes back, the keeper is firm but kind, and the friends leave lighter for having been caught; the maker's joke lands on the impulse, not the kids
constraints.must_not: threaten, lecture at length, or bar the friends from the tower forever

n_end_caught.beat_hint: the grab meets the maker's sense of humor; a gentle giveaway, a keeper, and a putting-right that costs only blushes.
